messages:
Alex Park: Heads-up — I'm kicking off coordination for a co-listing with Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant. Two parallel tracks: marketplace listing (Snow/DBX) and SI/hardware bundle (DGX/Aurora). Need owners for each track.
Maria Gonzalez: Can we lock a tentative announcement window? Snow asked for mid-April, ideally 4/15.
Tariq Khan: Ops question — are there infra or packaging constraints for a bundled offer on Snow Marketplace (e.g., container vs AMI, allowed metadata fields)? cc Samir.
Samir Patel: From eng: we'll need a minimal reference architecture doc, container image manifest, and a tiny ingest sample. I can draft the arch + manifest by EOW (3/26).
Alex Park: Hardware partners also want a visible SKU/bundle mention for DGX and Aurora edge nodes. Need pricing direction before legal review.
Maria Gonzalez: I'll loop in pricing and partnerships ops. Proposed milestones: internal review 3/28, legal sign-off 4/6, press/partner announcement 4/15. Thoughts?
Ecosystem Bot: Reminder — marketplace listing checklist items due in 7 days: product schema, logos, lead contact, support email.
Tariq Khan: For Qdrant we need a clear vector schema mapping + a sample ingest script that shows batch upserts and metadata. Samir, can you add the sample? e.g., `POST /vectors/upsert` + small JSON.
Samir Patel: Yep. Draft snippet I'll include in the repo. Inline example for the thread: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ingest -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"vectors":[{"id":"doc1","values":[0.1,0.2],"metadata":{"source":"snow-demo"}}]}'`
Alex Park: SI enablement plan — recommend 2 enablement webinars for SI engineers (one technical deep-dive, one go-to-market) during week of 4/1. Also need an SI-facing runbook.
Maria Gonzalez: Agreed. I'll draft invites and an initial press/partner comms outline. Snow asked that messaging be "validated integration" rather than implying exclusivity.
Tariq Khan: Support routing: propose shared pager and a triage runbook for first 72 hours post-launch. We should also define escalation to eng-oncall.
Samir Patel: We can wire alerts to a shared channel and add an escalation step in the runbook. I'll draft the runbook and add a sample SLO for the integration (p50/p95 inference latency, ingestion success rate).
Alex Park: Action items — Samir: reference arch + ingest sample by 3/26; Maria: draft announcement copy + partner approval timeline by 3/24; Tariq: support runbook & paging by 4/10. I'll drive legal/pricing coordination. :thumbsup:
Maria Gonzalez: SG — I'll update the shared doc with timelines: https://docs.redwood.com/partnerships/snow-dbx-qdrant-bundle (placeholder).
Tariq Khan: If Snow or DBX request SSO/SAML details, tag me and I'll supply the SAML metadata.
Samir Patel: Will open PR for code + manifest once draft is ready.
Alex Park: :rocket: Thanks everyone — we'll sync again on Friday for a quick status check.
